name: s14_mirror_condition_ends
purpose: Both sides set the same side conditions on the same turns, so Tailwind, Reflect and Light Screen of both sides run out in the same residual: the two end handlers tie (order 26, same sub-order) and the shuffle decides the order of their two end lines; a condition that is still up fails again with -fail and [still].
